purpose: Deterministic device, failure, time and state-transition parameters for QA browser tests. Data only: product assertions live in QA-owned files.
honesty: Every profile is an emulated viewport. Chromium emulation is not Android hardware; WebKit emulation is not iOS Safari hardware.

basis=trusted means the dimensions were already published in tests/device_matrix.js as non-estimated. basis=generic means a representative size chosen to exercise a layout class, not a specific device.
No Galaxy Z Fold 6 viewport is asserted here. Confirm the real cover/open CSS viewport on the device (innerWidth x innerHeight) before relying on fold-6 conclusions.

hardware_confirmation_needed.measure: window.innerWidth x window.innerHeight (cover, open, half-folded), devicePixelRatio, font scale

profiles.label: Small Android phone
profiles.role: common small phone; matches companion_smoke default

profiles.label: Generic Fold-open / small tablet
profiles.role: open foldable class; not a specific device

profiles.label: Phone landscape
profiles.role: short viewport; sticky bars may occlude content

profiles.label: WCAG 1.4.10 reflow width
profiles.role: 320 CSS px reflow; desktop UA so width is exact

profiles.role: breakpoint boundary (Listening Room header nav at >=900)

profiles.label: One pixel below 1100 breakpoint
profiles.role: breakpoint boundary (Companion wide layout at >=1100 in PR #82)

data_paths.note: Paths are relative to the served root. Required/optional split mirrors companion/app.js load(); update here if the loader changes.

failure_scenarios.label: Delayed required JSON
failure_scenarios.note: Every required file is held for delay_ms. The app aborts after 15 s; use delay_ms above 15000 with a fake-timer test to exercise that.

failure_scenarios.label: Required JSON fails N times then succeeds
failure_scenarios.note: Counts all required requests, three files per load, so 3 equals one failed load then recovery.

failure_scenarios.label: Required JSON is truncated (200, invalid JSON)
Required JSON is valid but has an unexpected shape
Thumbnail host answers with a 1x1 PNG
Network lost after a successful load

time_fixtures.note: Data checked_on 2026-10-31; before the Nov 6 staleness rule applies.
One second before festival-day-1 local midnight: freshness warning must not apply.
First instant of festival day 1: companion/lib.js freshnessWarning turns on when checked_on is earlier.
Schedule rows after midnight belong to the next calendar date but the same festival night.
US DST ends 2026-11-01 06:00 UTC. The 01:00 local hour occurs twice.

transitions.note: Viewport change only. Does not emulate the hinge, posture or window-segment APIs.
For cross-product Back, navigate between /companion/ and /listening-room/ with page.goto or link clicks in the QA test, then call goBack.

unsupported_simulations: Real iOS Safari, Samsung Internet, Android WebView or any hardware behavior
VoiceOver, TalkBack or any screen reader
Fold hinge/posture APIs and window segments
Browser or OS text-size and display-zoom settings. Use QA-owned CSS zoom or text-spacing injection and label it as such
Real mobile radio conditions. Offline and slow responses are simulated at the request layer
WebKit when the WebKit browser is not installed. The self-check reports it as skipped, not passed
